CoupleCloudRoom.title: CoupleCloudRoom
CoupleCloudRoom.description: Real-time bonded room connecting at most two authenticated partners via a 6-digit couple code. Stores only routing metadata; all game moves are stored as AES-256-GCM encrypted blockchain envelopes in the blocks subcollection.

coupleCode.description: 6-digit unique numeric room code matching the document ID.

creatorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the partner who created the room (immutable).

creatorName.description: Display name of the room creator (1-32 characters).

partnerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joining partner (empty string until joined, immutable once set).

partnerName.description: Display name of the joining partner (0-32 characters).

memberUids.description: Bounded list of 1 to 2 Firebase Auth UIDs belonging to the bonded couple.

spiceLevel.description: Shared couple vibe/spice level synced live between both devices.

status.description: Room lifecycle state; UNPAIRED is a terminal state locking further updates.

blockCount.description: Total number of encrypted blockchain blocks committed to this room.

latestBlockHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the most recently mined encrypted block.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on room creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every room update.

CoupleEncryptedBlock.title: CoupleEncryptedBlock
CoupleEncryptedBlock.description: Immutable, append-only AES-256-GCM + Proof-of-Work blockchain packet carrying an encrypted couple game move or handshake between two bonded phones.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender (must match request.auth.uid).

senderName.description: Sanitized display name of the sender (1-32 characters).

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of 1 to 2 bonded member UIDs for fast local security rule evaluation.

blockIndex.description: Monotonic index of this block in the couple blockchain ledger.

actionType.description: Type of encrypted couple game turn or lifecycle event.

encryptedPacket.description: AES-256-GCM + HMAC-SHA256 encrypted KRIMOON:BCHAIN: ciphertext envelope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on block creation.

/coupleRooms/{coupleCode}.description: Root collection of bonded 2-partner couple rooms keyed by their 6-digit coupleCode.

/coupleRooms/{coupleCode}/blocks/{blockI.description: Append-only stream of AES-256-GCM encrypted blockchain move envelopes for a couple room.
